stem: How does the author organize the selection?

options.label: A
options.text: By explaining problems happening in oceans and the work Mission Blue does to solve the problems

options.label: B
options.text: By describing in chronological order the actions that Mission Blue has taken to help oceans

options.label: C
options.text: By providing the causes of problems in the ocean and effects of the different ways Mission Blue helped with the problems

options.label: D
options.text: By describing mysteries of the oceans and how Mission Blue plans to learn more about oceans
